ucd-care-canine-glioma.identity: IACUC 24515 / AVMA 26-001. BAQ-13 IV twice weekly for 4 weeks with conventional fractionated RT
ucd-care-canine-glioma.recruitment_sites: Current clinical protocol and institution study listing. UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; VCCT vcct@ucdavis.edu / 530-754-1954.
ucd-care-canine-glioma.eligibility: Suspected high-grade glioma on MRI, planned conventional RT, fit for anesthesia/visits, two biopsies and consent to postmortem review.
ucd-care-canine-glioma.funding: Study MRI/CT except initial diagnostic MRI, biopsies, BAQ-13/monitoring and study hospitalization covered; $4,000 toward RT on completion; up to $3,000 for protocol complications treated at UC Davis.
ucd-care-canine-glioma.contacts: UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; VCCT vcct@ucdavis.edu / 530-754-1954.

ucd-prism-canine-glioma.identity: IACUC 24619 / VCCT-26-014. Observational PRISM follows planned conventional RT or palliative care; distinct treatment-access listing, no experimental therapy guaranteed
ucd-prism-canine-glioma.recruitment_sites: Current clinical protocol and institution study listing. UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; VCCT vcct@ucdavis.edu / 530-754-1954.
ucd-prism-canine-glioma.eligibility: Presumed high-grade glioma on MRI, palliative or conventional fractionated RT plan, fit for anesthesia, two biopsies and visits.
ucd-prism-canine-glioma.funding: $3,000 toward ongoing care; initial diagnostics and clinical care including seizure medications, steroids and RT are owner-paid subject to that credit.
ucd-prism-canine-glioma.contacts: UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; VCCT vcct@ucdavis.edu / 530-754-1954.

ucd-nasal-chemo-radiation.identity: IACUC 21239 (19410/17733), AAHSD000037. Prospective RT with or without intra-arterial chemotherapy; CT before and at four weeks.
ucd-nasal-chemo-radiation.recruitment_sites: Current clinical protocol and institution study listing. UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; Bill Culp wculp@ucdavis.edu.
ucd-nasal-chemo-radiation.eligibility: Dog diagnosed with nasal tumor already scheduled for radiation, study and CT visits.
ucd-nasal-chemo-radiation.funding: Study pays CT scans, chemotherapy administration and part of RT.
ucd-nasal-chemo-radiation.contacts: UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; Bill Culp wculp@ucdavis.edu.

ucd-nasal-tae.identity: IACUC 21863 (20094). TAE to occlude tumor blood supply with PET/CT before and at one month; distinct from the RT plus IA chemo trial.
ucd-nasal-tae.recruitment_sites: Current clinical protocol and institution study listing. UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; Bill Culp wculp@ucdavis.edu.
ucd-nasal-tae.eligibility: Dog diagnosed with nasal cancer, initial CT needed; invasion of adjacent structures may prevent enrollment.
ucd-nasal-tae.funding: Study pays two PET/CTs and anesthesia; owner pays TAE, procedure complications and screening CT if ineligible.
ucd-nasal-tae.contacts: UC Davis Veterinary Medical Teaching Hospital, Davis CA; Bill Culp wculp@ucdavis.edu.

tamu-feline-small-cell-gi-lymphoma-wart.identity: Texas A&M exact StudyPages study 358215. Whole-abdomen radiation for feline small-cell GI lymphoma, distinct from CSU 8528 three fractions and Missouri high-grade chemo combination.
tamu-feline-small-cell-gi-lymphoma-wart.recruitment_sites: Current clinical protocol and institution study listing. Texas A&M Small Animal Teaching Hospital, College Station; Lisa Even vetclinicaltrials@tamu.edu.
tamu-feline-small-cell-gi-lymphoma-wart.eligibility: Biopsy confirmed small-cell GI lymphoma, newly diagnosed difficult to medicate or relapsed after chemo; no chemo/steroids seven days prior, labs within 14 days; owner lives within six hours drive of College Station.
tamu-feline-small-cell-gi-lymphoma-wart.funding: Study costs after enrollment covered; initial screening labs and possible overnight housing owner-paid.
tamu-feline-small-cell-gi-lymphoma-wart.contacts: Texas A&M Small Animal Teaching Hospital, College Station; Lisa Even vetclinicaltrials@tamu.edu.

mvh-hifu-doxorubicin-lymphoma.identity: VCSC-2026-A007 / CT-0033. Therapeutic HIFU to one target lymph node and five doxorubicin treatments beginning day 8; not Purdue UW-25 CHOP study.
mvh-hifu-doxorubicin-lymphoma.recruitment_sites: Current clinical protocol and institution study listing. Active – Recruiting and complete Study Locations tab shows only VCA Dallas Animal Specialty Hospital, 17727 Dallas Pkwy Suite 150. Zachary Wright/Rachel Kovac, official intake route.
mvh-hifu-doxorubicin-lymphoma.eligibility: Confirmed canine nodal B- or T-cell lymphoma with prescapular or popliteal target node.
mvh-hifu-doxorubicin-lymphoma.funding: Sponsor covers study imaging, bloodwork, HIFU and five doxorubicin treatments; outside workup/travel not specified.
mvh-hifu-doxorubicin-lymphoma.contacts: Active – Recruiting and complete Study Locations tab shows only VCA Dallas Animal Specialty Hospital, 17727 Dallas Pkwy Suite 150. Zachary Wright/Rachel Kovac, official intake route.

eu-it-unimi-oncofap-mmae.identity: OncoFAP-linked monomethyl auristatin E, four IV treatments at weekly intervals, OPBA822022.
eu-it-unimi-oncofap-mmae.recruitment_sites: University of Milan Veterinary Teaching Hospital, Lodi, Italy, current owner page with named study and prescreen; confirm individual slot.
eu-it-unimi-oncofap-mmae.eligibility: Canine FAP-positive spontaneous tumor unsuitable for surgery/standard treatment or symptomatic distant metastases, clinical/organ and lab screening. Source heart-threshold wording internally ambiguous, so team screens.
eu-it-unimi-oncofap-mmae.funding: Study pays biopsy/FAP, pre/post CT/anesthesia, four doses, study labs; unrelated tests owner-paid.
eu-it-unimi-oncofap-mmae.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; care schedule and file timestamp are not a cutoff.

eu-fr-oral-intratumoral-immunotherapy.identity: VetAgro Sup/FINDIMMUNE intratumoral experimental drug on days 1, 30, 90; drug not named.
eu-fr-oral-intratumoral-immunotherapy.recruitment_sites: VetAgro Sup CICV clinical campus Marcy-l’Étoile, France, current study-specific clinic appointment.
eu-fr-oral-intratumoral-immunotherapy.eligibility: Dog with confirmed malignant oral melanoma or squamous cell carcinoma; diagnostic selection and 10 visits in 6 months.
eu-fr-oral-intratumoral-immunotherapy.funding: Study treatment and medical follow-up covered; initial selection/diagnostics and travel not specified.
eu-fr-oral-intratumoral-immunotherapy.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; care schedule and file timestamp are not a cutoff.

illinois-osa-sbrt-dc-homing-hydrogel.identity: Three daily SBRT fractions followed by dendritic-cell homing hydrogel near tumor after fraction three.
illinois-osa-sbrt-dc-homing-hydrogel.recruitment_sites: University of Illinois Veterinary Teaching Hospital, Urbana, listed exact current study PDF.
illinois-osa-sbrt-dc-homing-hydrogel.eligibility: Dogs >1yr, ≥5kg, confirmed appendicular OSA, no thoracic/abdominal metastases or prior chemotherapy/RT/immunotherapy; no Apoquel/steroids/immune-modulators within 14d; adequate organs, no autoimmune disease.
illinois-osa-sbrt-dc-homing-hydrogel.funding: Trial CT, biopsy, RT, hydrogel, follow-up and bloodwork covered. Owner pays eligibility workup, ~ $250 initial consult, pain meds and unrelated care.
illinois-osa-sbrt-dc-homing-hydrogel.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; care schedule and file timestamp are not a cutoff.

illinois-daunomustine-multicentric-lymph.identity: IV daunomustine up to five escalating doses every two weeks, possible L-asparaginase for incomplete remission.
illinois-daunomustine-multicentric-lymph.recruitment_sites: University of Illinois Veterinary Teaching Hospital, Urbana, current roster exact PDF.
illinois-daunomustine-multicentric-lymph.eligibility: Confirmed peripheral-node multicentric lymphoma in dog ≥1yr and ≥4kg, no small-cell/indolent or prior chemo/systemic steroids, topicals permitted; adequate marrow/organs and no DCM/CHF.
illinois-daunomustine-multicentric-lymph.funding: Study fully funded after eligibility; partial coverage of adverse events at Illinois and $1,000 VTH credit on qualifying completion or removal. Owner pays pre-entry workup and unrelated care.
illinois-daunomustine-multicentric-lymph.deadline: No published recruitment cutoff; care schedule and file timestamp are not a cutoff.

osu-osa-ai-sbrt.identity: Ohio State specific AI fracture risk plus conditional stabilization after three SBRT treatments, and standard carboplatin up to six doses. Assigned supportive implant within known treatment-access pathway.
osu-osa-ai-sbrt.recruitment_sites: Current Ohio State individual protocol and patient prescreen, Veterinary Medical Center, Columbus.
osu-osa-ai-sbrt.eligibility: Radiographically suspected or cytology/histology confirmed limb OSA; plan for SBRT and chemo; no lung metastasis or fracture at screening.
osu-osa-ai-sbrt.funding: Study pays limb CT, gait, implant/anesthesia and specified procedures; $1,000 on completion; radiation and chemo owner-paid.
osu-osa-ai-sbrt.contacts: Laura Selmic Selmic.1@osu.edu, Emily Pope pope.202@osu.edu.

selection_cases.osa_location: Axial — skull, spine, rib, or pelvis

osu-sts-mic-nk.identity: Anti-MIC antibody injection and infusion of tumor-derived expanded NK cells in canine STS.
osu-sts-mic-nk.recruitment_sites: Current Ohio State individual protocol and patient prescreen, Veterinary Medical Center, Columbus.
osu-sts-mic-nk.eligibility: Localized cytology/histology-confirmed STS, otherwise healthy; no immune deficiency, immunosuppressants, or previous local RT.
osu-sts-mic-nk.funding: All trial procedures covered after enrollment plus $700 on completion.

osu-oral-melanoma.identity: Intratumoral weakened LCMV followed by resection and possible infusion of expanded tumor lymphocytes after progression; control omits virus but still provides cell collection.
osu-oral-melanoma.recruitment_sites: Current Ohio State individual protocol and patient prescreen, Veterinary Medical Center, Columbus.
osu-oral-melanoma.eligibility: Localized confirmed oral melanoma accessible to injection/needle biopsy, otherwise healthy; no immune deficiency/immunosuppression or prior local RT.
osu-oral-melanoma.funding: Study biopsy, two CTs, study bloodwork, viral agent/injections and immune-cell procedures covered; $800 incentive after study.

spain-puchol-reachglio-2026.identity: ReachGlio AEMPS authorized, IV SNGR-TNF plus oral temozolomide six cycles q21d.
spain-puchol-reachglio-2026.recruitment_sites: Current Spanish Puchol recruitment notice; only Hospital Veterinario Puchol, Madrid.
spain-puchol-reachglio-2026.eligibility: Canine presumed high-grade glioma based on MRI/neuro evaluation, ≥7kg and full study-team screening.
spain-puchol-reachglio-2026.funding: TRANSCAN-3 covers protocol drugs/therapy, follow-up MRI and study labs. Initial nonprotocol costs not guaranteed.
